extension_policy.rule: Add narrow IDs only when routing, diagnosis, validation, or explanation needs the distinction.

reasoning_types.label: Workflow composition
reasoning_types.description: Compose skills, hooks, artifacts, and validators into an end-to-end visible workflow.

reasoning_types.label: Deterministic validation
reasoning_types.description: Check schemas, paths, lifecycle events, and gate conditions without generative judgment.

reasoning_types.label: Generative reasoning
reasoning_types.description: Use judgment-heavy skills to enrich goals, diagnose frame gaps, or interpret release risk.

reasoning_types.label: Dependency closure
reasoning_types.description: Recursively expose proof, bridge, premise, route, and evidence obligations.

reasoning_types.label: Abductive reasoning
reasoning_types.description: Generate and test missing-premise or bridge-object hypotheses.

reasoning_types.label: Deductive reasoning
reasoning_types.description: Derive conservative consequences from local premises and dependency traces.

reasoning_types.label: Proof search
reasoning_types.description: Move from discovery artifacts to theorem-shaped proof or disproof attempts.

reasoning_types.label: Evidence assessment
reasoning_types.description: Assess grounding, provenance, validation sufficiency, drift, and release evidence.

problem_domain_types.label: Theorem discovery
problem_domain_types.description: Informal mathematical discovery and proof-route construction.

problem_domain_types.label: Complexity theory
problem_domain_types.description: Complexity classes, reductions, lower bounds, and barriers.

problem_domain_types.label: Proof engineering
problem_domain_types.description: Proof queues, proof attempts, Lean-like theorem shapes, and local InformalMathLib records.

problem_domain_types.label: Agentic control plane
problem_domain_types.description: Looper-style governance, hooks, workflow contracts, and release gates.

task_context_types.label: Target navigation
task_context_types.description: Start from a target and recursively control dependency discovery and skill use.

task_context_types.label: Goal enrichment
task_context_types.description: Turn a raw target into quality criteria, validation targets, and gates.

task_context_types.label: Dependency cartography
task_context_types.description: Build and audit recursive proof dependency graphs.

task_context_types.label: Workflow governance
task_context_types.description: Validate visible workflow contracts, gates, hooks, and handoffs.

task_context_types.label: Release promotion
task_context_types.description: Promote, quarantine, roll back, or escalate a controlled iteration.
